# Savings memo

Switching to the recommended internet and phone plans saves the Raman household $3,274.36 over 24 months.

## Internet

**Recommended: Fiberly Fiber 500** (offer id `int-fiberly-500`), available in ZIP3 951.
- Why it is eligible: 520 Mbps typical download (500 minimum), 500 Mbps upload (20 minimum), no data cap, no contract, available in your area.
- Price: $65/mo regular, $5/mo autopay discount, $99 one-time professional installation, no equipment rental, no monthly fees, no taxes. Price locked for 36 months.
- Cost: **$819.00 over 12 months** and **$1,539.00 over 24 months**.

**Runner-up: Fiberly Fiber 1 Gig** (`int-fiberly-1g`): eligible and available, but $1,899.00 over 24 months ($999.00 over 12 months). It is faster than you need and costs more.

**Rejected offers:**
- Bayline Performance 500 (`int-bayline-perf-500`): upload is 10 Mbps, below your 20 Mbps minimum.
- Bayline Connect 600 (`int-bayline-connect-600`, Sponsored): data cap of 1,229 GB, below your highest month of 1,452 GB (July 2026).
- Bayline Gigabit Loyalty (`int-bayline-gig-loyalty`, Sponsored): eligible, but $2,148.00 over 24 months, so it ranks third.
- SkyLink Home 5G (`int-skylink-home-5g`, Sponsored): typical speed 415 Mbps, below 500 Mbps.
- Sonic Wave Wave 1G (`int-sonic-wave-1g`): 12-month contract, and you do not want contracts.
- Lonestar Fiber 1 Gig (`int-lonestar-fiber-1g`): not available in ZIP3 951.
- MetroNet Fiber 500 (`int-metronet-500`): not available in ZIP3 951.
- Hill Country Max 500 (`int-hillcountry-cable-500`, Sponsored): not available in ZIP3 951.

## Phones

**Recommended: Orbit Mobile Essentials Unlimited** (offer id `mob-orbit-essentials`), three lines, keeps all your numbers.
- Why it is eligible: unlimited data on every line, so no per-line data cap can be exceeded. Hotspot allowance is 20 GB per line, which covers Priya's highest month of 16.4 GB (July 2026). Mexico is not included, but a day pass is sold for $10/day. Arjun's roughly 10 travel days a year are priced in below. Available in ZIP3 951.
- Price: $25/line, $75/mo for three lines, plus $9/mo taxes. No autopay discount, no contract.
- Roaming cost: Arjun's line (B) travels about 5 days twice a year, so 10 days a year at $10/day = $100/yr, or $200 over 24 months.
- Cost: **$1,108.00 over 12 months** and **$2,216.00 over 24 months** (includes the $200 of day passes).

**Runner-up: Northstar Unlimited Max** (`mob-northstar-max`): eligible and available. It includes Mexico roaming and 50 GB hotspot per line, at $120/mo less $15 autopay, $0 tax: **$1,260.00 over 12 months** and **$2,520.00 over 24 months**.

**Rejected offers:**
- Pebble Mobile Unlimited (`mob-pebble-unlimited`): hotspot is 10 GB per line, below Priya's 16.4 GB peak.
- Tandem Wireless Flex Shared 60 (`mob-tandem-flex-60`): the 60 GB shared pool is below the July 2026 combined use of 71.0 GB once hotspot (which uses plan data) is counted.
- Volt Mobile Volt 15 (`mob-volt-15`, Sponsored): 15 GB per line, below Priya's 41.0 GB peak in July 2026.
- Carrierco Unlimited Welcome (`mob-carrierco-welcome`, Sponsored): hotspot is 5 GB per line, below Priya's 16.4 GB peak. Also, its $90/mo promo applies only for 12 months.

## Next steps
- Order Fiberly Fiber 500 with autopay and paperless billing. Ask for the professional installation ($99) and confirm the 36-month price lock in writing.
- Order Orbit Mobile Essentials Unlimited for three lines, porting all three numbers. Confirm the 20 GB hotspot per line and the $10/day Mexico day pass before Arjun's trips.
- Keep Bayline and CarrierCo active until the new internet and phone service are confirmed working, then cancel them.
- Return the Bayline XB-8 modem rental after the Fiberly install so the $15/mo rental charge stops.
- Before each Mexico trip, buy day passes for Arjun's line only on days he needs them ($10/day).
